predecessors.name: Kingdom of Greece
predecessors.text: the Greek state of the First Hellenic Republic row, which Cliopatria ends in 1940; the Kingdom of Greece 'remained in exile in Egypt' (Hellenic State page)

successors.name: Kingdom of Greece
successors.text: 'German troops evacuated Athens on 12 October 1944, and by the end of the month, they had withdrawn from mainland Greece'; 'The first British troops under General Scobie arrived in Athens on 14…

ledger.x: 30 April 1941: Georgios Tsolakoglou is appointed prime minister of the occupation government in Athens.
April 1941: the Germans hold Athens, Thessaloniki and Macedonia.
April 1941: the Italians hold most of the Greek mainland south and west.
14 May 1941: Bulgaria annexes eastern Macedonia and Western Thrace.
September 1943: Germany takes over the former Italian zone, Epirus, western Greece and the Peloponnese.
12-31 October 1944: the Germans leave mainland Greece.
12 October 1944: the German zone of Athens, Thessaloniki and Macedonia is evacuated.
October 1944: German rule of the Hellenic State ends, though Crete and some Aegean islands were held until May-June 1945.
14 October 1944: the Greek government returns to Athens.
October 1944: the Hellenic State ends with the German withdrawal.

wars.name: Battle of Greece
wars.outcome: Germany invaded on 6 April 1941; Athens fell on 27 April; Bulgaria entered Greek Thrace on 20 April and annexed it on 14 May; Crete was taken by 1 June, when 'all of Greece was under Axis occupation'.

certainty.note: The pages name the zones by region and army corps, not by line; the Bulgarian annexation line, the Italian-German zone line and the Ionian Islands' status are not located.
